import java.util.Scanner;

public class E {
    private static final long MOD = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        long L = sc.nextLong();
        long R = sc.nextLong();
        
        long range = R - L + 1;
        long odd = (L % 2 == 1) ? (range + 1) / 2 : range / 2;
        long even = range - odd;
        
        long cells = n * m;
        
        if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
            // Total cells is odd
            long totalWays = modPow(odd + even, cells);
            long validWays = (modPow(even, cells) + modPow(odd, cells)) % MOD;
            System.out.println(validWays);
        } else {
            // Total cells is even
            long totalWays = modPow(odd + even, cells);
            long validWays = (modPow(even, cells) + modPow(odd, cells)) % MOD;
            System.out.println(validWays);
        }
    }

    private static long modPow(long base, long exp) {
        long res = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                res = (res * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return res;
    }
}
